candidates.title: TQCompressor: Improving Tensor Decomposition Methods in Neural Networks Via Permutations
candidates.venue: Conference on Multimedia Information Processing and Retrieval
candidates.abstract: We introduce TQCompressor a neural network model compression method using enhanced tensor decompositions. We propose a permutation-based improvement to Kronecker decomposition, reducing the loss in model expressivity typically associated with compression. Applied to $\mathbf{GPT-2}_{small}$, this results in the TQCompressedGPT-2 model with 81 million parameters, down from 124 million. Enhanced through multi-step knowledge distillation on 3.1% of OpenWebText, TQCompressedGPT-2 outperforms DistilGPT-2 and KnGPT-2. We made TQCompressedGPT-2 publicly available.
candidates.reason: TQCompressorは順列で強化したKronecker分解によるテンソル分解圧縮でGPT-2を124Mから81Mパラメータへ圧縮し、多段階知識蒸留でDistilGPT-2等を上回り、資源制約環境への効率的デプロイを実現するモデル圧縮手法であり、推論向け圧縮に直接貢献する。

candidates.title: A 198.7 μJ/token Block Diffusion LLM Processor with Mask Token Similarity-Based Activation Reuse
candidates.venue: International Symposium on Circuits and Systems
candidates.abstract: This paper presents an energy-efficient diffusion-based large language model processor. Diffusion-based large language models have attained significant attention for their computational parallelism, which enables both high token generation speed and energy efficiency. However, their inherent block-based architecture still contains redundancies that can be further optimized. The proposed processor achieves high energy efficiency and low token generation latency with three key features as solutions: 1) Mask token similarity-based activation reuse (MTAR) to reduce computation energy of global prefill stage by 70.6%, 2) Continuous confidence-based mixed precision (CCMP) to allow 94.2% of the local block decoding stage workload to be processed with low-precision activation. 3) Reordering shared bit-slice core (RSBC) architecture to reduce computation energy of local block decoding stage by 46.3%. The proposed processor is implemented in 28 nm CMOS technology and achieves 32.8 TOPS peak throughput with 10.1 TOPS/W. In sum, 198.7 μJ/token highly energy-efficient diffusion-based LLM processor can be achieved on the GSM8K dataset.
candidates.reason: ブロック拡散LLM向けプロセッサで、マスクトークン類似度に基づく活性化再利用でプリフィルの計算エネルギーを70.6％削減し、信頼度連動の混合精度と共有ビットスライスコアでブロックデコードも省力化して198.7μJ/tokenを達成しており、拡散型LLM推論ハードウェアに直接貢献する。
